integrity: Self-review mathematical proof and finite reproducibility tests; no independent scientific audit or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional deterministic harmonic confinement and symmetric run/zero/return velocity transitions with strictly positive finite exponential rates only.
No independent translational diffusion or asymmetric turn selection.
Latent variables represent the stationary position and run/tumble flag, not velocity direction or multi-time trajectories.

The marginal stationary density and conditional motility densities are prior literature; originality is restricted to the stochastic ordering, joint latent representation, and universal near-wall law.
title: Beta–Bernoulli stationary coupling and universal near-wall motility in a run-and-tumble trap
